llm.title: AI Explain
llm.description: Configure a language model to explain queue findings and traces in plain language.
llm.managedModelNote: Qarote selects the model for you — no API key or configuration needed.
llm.modelPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the default
llm.apiKeySaved: Key saved — enter a new value to replace it
llm.upgradeDescription: AI explanations are available on the Developer plan and above.

quota.title: Monthly AI explanation usage
quota.byok: You're using your own API key — calls aren't metered against a Qarote quota.

sso.upgradeDescription: SSO with OIDC and SAML 2.0 is available on the Enterprise plan.
sso.upgradeCloudHint: Upgrade your plan to configure single sign-on for your organization.
sso.upgradeSelfHostedHint: Activate an Enterprise license to configure single sign-on for your organization.

license.accessDenied: License management is reserved for organization admins.

agentAccess.title: Agent Access
agentAccess.description: Mint and revoke machine API keys so AI agents can call Qarote's MCP endpoint (read incidents, scan findings, and explain incidents on EE).

empty.title: No agent keys yet
empty.description: Mint a key above to grant an AI agent (Claude Desktop, Cursor, …) access to your workspace via MCP.

mint.title: Mint a new key
mint.scopeReadConsequence: List incidents and findings. No LLM use.
mint.scopeExplainConsequence: Includes grounded RCA via LLM — counts against your workspace quota.
mint.expiryNeverWarning: A key with no expiry stays valid until you revoke it manually. Prefer a short horizon when possible.

reveal.title: Save this key now
reveal.description: If you close without copying, this key is unrecoverable — you'll need to mint a new one. Qarote stores only a hash.
reveal.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the text and copy manually.
reveal.confirm: I have copied the secret to a safe place.

revoke.title: Revoke this agent key?
revoke.description: "{{name}}" will stop working immediately. Any agent using this key needs a new one.
